seed: Writing a five minute Retina recording out at 1080p, at Next defaults with no flag touched, the way the Export sheet's button does: the card comes up and moves while the window stays free to draw, and the file lands in well under half the time the five minutes run.

steps.note: Five minutes of a Retina recording took nearly six minutes to write at 1080p, longer than it plays. Premiere writes a screen recording several times faster than it plays. This walk starts that export the way the sheet does and watches the card and the window while it writes
The card is up, saying what it writes and how far along it is
